job.title: Systems Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure solutions, making computing invisible anywhere. We are excited to bring in a new wave of talented Technical Support Engineers into our company! If you are someone that: loves technology and innovation; have a customer-first mindset; has an eagerness to learn and wants to enhance your skillset in our leading Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) technology and Hybrid-Cloud solutions, come be part of the family and help us provide our customers with an exceptional support experience. 


About the Team

Here at Nutanix we drive the success of our customers through passion and teamwork, ensuring quick response times and unparalleled customer satisfaction; our 90/100 NPS score is a testament to such objective. Our diverse, multicultural team of top-notch engineers act as our customers champions, working closely with Engineering, Field, and Sales teams. Our teams love to have constant learning opportunities and aim to become experts in Virtualization, Networking and Storage. 

You will report to the Worldwide Support Manager who is dedicated to fostering a positive work environment and providing the necessary guidance and resources for your success. 

We are a fully hybrid team based in Kent Street, Sydney. We operate 3 days from the office and meet up as a full team to reconnect, share ideas and to socialize outside of working hours! We organize our working shifts and aim towards the appropriate work-life balance for all our team members. 


Your Role

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and diagnose customer issues encountered in the field.
  • Improve the serviceability of the product by testing new features and developing tools to scale our field deployment and auto-support infrastructure.
  • Provide analysis of our existing customer base to avoid and minimize risks in the field.
  • Define and lead changes to our product with our development engineering team based on feedback from customers and field implementations.
  • Work with technology partners (e.g. VMware, Citrix, Microsoft) to resolve issues and push improvements in our ecosystem.
  • Develop and work on internal and external knowledge bases.
  • Provide support on weekdays and also off hours on an as-needed and scheduled rotational basis.
  • Be a champion for our customers. Go above and beyond to support their business and use of the Nutanix stack.

What You Will Bring

  • Proven work experience in troubleshooting at least two of the following: Virtualization (preferably VMware ESXi), Networking (preferably layer 2/3), Linux Systems (preferably CLI administration), Storage Analysis
  • Experience supporting external customers and a customer first mindset.
  • Multilingual (Korean / Mandarin) will be highly regarded
  • Passion and ability to learn new things

job.title: Senior Enterprise Account Manager
job.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Nutanix is looking for an Senior Enterprise Account Manager to join our team in Austria to build and manage a mix accounts, with focus on strategic and large Enterprise Accounts. As a Senior Enterprise Account Manager, you are responsible for selling Nutanix Solutions and Services directly to large Enterprise customers. You will also be working closely with a dedicated Systems Engineer.

Success in this role requires a strong focus on developing new business across Austria, while also strategically managing and expanding existing accounts. The position covers a mixed Enterprise and Mid-Market customer base, with responsibility for selling Nutanix products and solutions through channel partners, while collaborating closely with alliances, ISVs, and engaging directly with customers. Nutanix provides strong support and resources from Engineering, Marketing, and Product Development to enable consistent achievement and overperformance against sales goals.

 

About the Team

At Nutanix, you will be joining the Austrian team. The team is composed of dedicated individuals who are passionate about driving success for our clients. With a focus on open communication, honesty, and collaboration, you can expect a supportive and inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives and teamwork.
As part of the Enterprise Sales Team, you will travel to associated client meetings, conferences, and sales engagements. We encourage to meet with clients in various locations, allowing you to build relationships and drive business growth through face-to-face interactions. Nutanix values personal connections and understands the importance of in-person engagements in fostering strong client relationships and driving sales success. 
 

Your Role

  • Drive net-new business and win new logos across Austria, growing Nutanix’s footprint within named Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts
  • Grow sales across the full Nutanix portfolio by identifying new opportunities and expanding existing customer engagements
  • Engage directly with customers to understand business and technical needs, positioning Nutanix solutions through consultative, solution-based selling
  • Articulate the Nutanix value proposition, including product capabilities, USPs, licensing, and pricing
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with channel partners, alliances, and ISVs
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Systems Engineering, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Product Development
  • Leverage strong communication and presentation skills to drive pipeline and execute sales initiatives
  • Consistently achieve sales targets and contribute to overall team objectives through individual performance

 

What You Will Bring

  • Proven track record in sales, with 10+ years of experience.Pronounced focus on customer success.
  • Strong understanding of sales processes and techniques, particularly in the IT industry.
  • Experience in the infrastructure domain.
  • Excellent communication skills in both German and English, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.
  • Passion in aligning business needs with technology solutions.

Work Arrangement

This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in-office requirement, however, we try to get together on a regular basis, or there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.
The work arrangement for this role will be discussed with the hiring manager.

Pay Transparency

The OTE range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between €146,000 and €218,000 per year.

Please note that OTE offered may vary depending on relevant objective factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

job.title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
Sao Paulo, Brazil Hungry, Humble, Honest, with heart!

The Opportunity Nutanix is looking for a highly experienced and strategically minded Enterprise Account Executive (IC5) to lead the development and penetration of a select group of Brazil's most strategic enterprise organizations. This is a strategic greenfield / whitespace role focused on acquiring new customers across Brazil's largest enterprise corporate groups, particularly within the telecommunications and conglomerate sectors. The successful candidate will build the business from the ground up while leveraging deep knowledge of the accounts, organizational structures, business priorities, technology environments, and decision-making processes. This is not a traditional account management role. It is a strategic penetration and new-logo position for an experienced enterprise hunter who can build executive relationships, create demand, navigate complex organizations, and establish Nutanix as a strategic technology partner. The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working directly with these strategic accounts or closely related enterprise ecosystems, with established relationships and a strong understanding of how these organizations operate.

Enterprise Sales at Nutanix The Enterprise Sales team in Brazil is focused on helping the country's largest and most complex organizations modernize their IT environments and accelerate business transformation. You will work closely with a dedicated Pre-Sales Engineer and cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Renewals, Partners, Marketing, and Professional Services. You will also collaborate frequently with the US Enterprise team, requiring fluent and effective communication in English, while leveraging global resources and expertise to engage strategically with complex enterprise organizations.

Your Role

  • Develop and execute strategic, multi-year account plans to penetrate a focused portfolio of enterprise accounts.

  • Leverage existing relationships to establish access to CIOs, CTOs, business executives, and other senior decision makers.

  • Map complex organizational structures, business units, stakeholders, influencers, champions, and procurement organizations.

  • Identify and develop whitespace opportunities across infrastructure, cloud, virtualization, applications, data, and broader IT transformation initiatives.

  • Own the acquisition of new customers and drive complex, high-value opportunities from prospecting through close.

  • Create demand and develop compelling business cases connecting Nutanix solutions to measurable business outcomes.

  • Lead multi-threaded sales cycles and navigate complex technical, commercial, procurement, legal, and executive environments.

  • Orchestrate Nutanix resources, partners, and customer stakeholders to develop and execute winning strategies.

  • Maintain strong pipeline, forecasting, and opportunity management discipline, with full accountability for territory performance.

  • Establish Nutanix as a long-term strategic partner and expand relationships across multiple companies and business units within each corporate group.

What You Bring

  • Significant enterprise technology sales experience in Brazil, with a proven track record of achieving or exceeding quota in a new-logo / hunting environment.

  • Several years of experience and established relationships within the target accounts or closely related enterprise ecosystems.

  • Demonstrated ability to penetrate large, complex organizations and create opportunities in greenfield or whitespace environments.

  • Proven executive-level selling experience with CIOs, CTOs, and senior business leaders.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, business acumen, and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to develop sophisticated strategic account and territory plans.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT, including cloud, infrastructure, data center, virtualization, applications, or related technologies.

  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.

  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and sales execution discipline.

  • Ability to operate independently, take ownership, and thrive in a highly competitive environment.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders in both languages.

What Success Looks Like Success will be measured not only by bookings, but by the ability to build a sustainable Nutanix franchise across a strategically important portfolio of enterprise organizations. The successful candidate will:

  • Establish meaningful executive relationships across the assigned accounts.

  • Accelerate Nutanix's penetration by leveraging existing relationships and account knowledge.

  • Build significant qualified pipeline from a greenfield starting point.

  • Win new logos and establish Nutanix as a strategic technology partner.

  • Develop opportunities across multiple companies and business units within each corporate group.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed quota.

The Ideal Candidate You are an experienced strategic enterprise hunter who already understands how Brazil's largest and most complex organizations operate. You know how to turn relationships into executive access, executive access into business conversations, and business conversations into strategic opportunities. You are a builder who is comfortable starting with little or no installed base and creating a significant business where none exists today. Most importantly, you bring the relationships, executive credibility, business acumen, and persistence required to strategically penetrate complex organizations and establish Nutanix as a long-term strategic partner.

Learn more about http://www.nutanix.com/careers. #LI-Hybrid

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

job.title: Member of Technical Staff 2- DataHub
job.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Are you an enthusiastic early-career engineer passionate about building secure AI infrastructure from the ground up? Join Nutanix to help develop our DataHub platform—an enterprise data hub and identity middleware engine positioned between raw infrastructure/SaaS platforms and downstream search, retrieval, and AI application clients. This is your chance to work with cutting-edge technology, automating data ingestion, sensitive data classification, security governance, and identity-aware retrieval. Be at the forefront of enterprise data innovation in a collaborative environment that fosters hands-on growth and mentorship.

About the Team

At Nutanix, you'll join the DataHub team, a geo-dispersed group of talented professionals dedicated to pushing boundaries and delivering trusted enterprise data solutions. Our team's diverse skill sets enable us to solve complex challenges in enterprise search, data access, and governance while supporting one another in a dynamic atmosphere.

You will report to the Technical Director, who is committed to mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive environment. The work setup is hybrid, requiring you to be in the office at our Vancouver office three days a week for valuable in-person collaboration. There are very mild travel requirements for this position.

Your Role

  • Design and construct enterprise-grade connectors for varied data sources.

  • Implement robust access control policies to eliminate unauthorized data exposure during search queries.

  • Create and refine CPU-optimized and GPU based text classification rules and metadata tagging to detect and safeguard sensitive information (PII, PHI, financial records, credentials) using Regular Expressions (Regex) and Named Entity Recognition (NER).

  • Develop and write clean unit and integration tests for document extraction, classification, and ingestion pipelines.

  • Partner with senior engineering staff to design, test, and enhance enterprise search and retrieval pipelines.

What You Will Bring

  • Education & Experience: You recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Engineering field with 1.5-3 years of relevant work experience or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related Engineering field

  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python, Golang, or modern backend engineering technologies.

  • Architecture Awareness: Exposure to vector databases, enterprise storage solutions, REST APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and identity-aware search/retrieval systems.

  • Core Engineering Concepts: Solid foundation in data structures, enterprise-grade security standards, and Git-based version control.

  • Text Classification & NLP (Good to Have): Familiarity with regex pattern matching, entity recognition libraries (e.g., spaCy, MedSpaCy, NLTK), and techniques for validating sensitive data types.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated, growth-oriented, and eager to be mentored by seasoned technical leaders.

 

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between CAD $ 103,000 and CAD $ 155,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

job.title: Member of Technical Staff 2- EIE
job.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Are you an ambitious software engineer looking to solve complex distributed systems challenges and build enterprise-grade platform infrastructure? Join Nutanix as a Member of Technical Staff 2 (MTS-2). In this role, you will design, develop, and deliver scalable, resilient backend services and platform components that power our enterprise cloud solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to tackle real-world engineering problems, collaborate with world-class technical talent, and grow your career in a dynamic, high-impact environment.

About the Team

At Nutanix, you will join a geo-dispersed, highly collaborative team of engineering professionals dedicated to simplifying multi-cloud infrastructure and enterprise software management. Our team thrives on innovation, technical excellence, and mutual support to solve complex engineering problems.

You will report to a Technical Director who is committed to supporting your career development and technical growth. The work setup is hybrid, requiring you to be in our Vancouver office three days a week for in-person collaboration. There are very mild travel requirements for this position.

Your Role

  • Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, resilient backend services and software components.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code adhering to enterprise software engineering standards.

  • Develop automated unit and integration test suites to maintain high software quality, security, and reliability.

  • Participate in architectural reviews, design discussions, and peer code reviews.

  • Troubleshoot complex bugs and performance bottlenecks across multi-tiered distributed systems.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Product Management, QA, and DevOps—to deliver end-to-end features on schedule.

What You Will Bring

  • Degree Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience: 2 to 5 years of professional software development experience building backend platform systems or cloud applications.

  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python, Golang, Java, or C++.

  • Core Systems Knowledge: Solid foundation in computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and OS concepts.

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Practical experience with Linux systems, RESTful API design, microservice architectures, and Git-based workflows.

  • Cloud & Containers (Plus): Exposure to container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, or public/private cloud environments.

  • Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, proactive ownership, and a desire to learn and collaborate.

 

Work Arrangement

job.title: Member of Technical Staff 2- Service Provider
job.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

 

The Opportunity

Build on your academic foundation and gain hands-on experience as a Software Developer. You’ll join a team focused on building high quality, scalable software while learning industry best practices and modern development tools. This role offers you the opportunity to expand your programming skills, work on real product features, and collaborate closely with experienced engineers who will help guide your growth.

You’ll have the chance to learn from talented professionals with diverse technical backgrounds, including cloud infrastructure engineers, full stack developers, automation specialists, and more. We hope to learn from you too!

 

About the Team

At Nutanix, we are building Service Provider (SP) Central to redefine global cloud infrastructure by delivering the simplicity and scale of public cloud management directly to on-premises environments. As a critical backbone of our platform, SP Central empowers two massive industry ecosystems: Managed Service Providers (MSPs) delivering secure, multi-tenant enterprise cloud transitions, and Neoclouds pioneering the next generation of AI-first infrastructure with GPU-as-a-Service and Models-as-a-Service. By joining our team, you will tackle high-impact distributed systems challenges—from granular role-based access control to isolating "noisy neighbors" in compute-intensive AI workloads. You will be at the forefront of designing scalable architectures that allow the world's most innovative service providers to seamlessly manage complex, multi-tenant environments. Join us to engineer the cutting-edge infrastructure that makes ubiquitous, invisible cloud computing a reality.

 

Your Role

  • Learn Nutanix development practices, tools, and architecture with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Contribute to the design, development, and testing of new product features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well documented code.
  • Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and technical planning sessions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including QA, SRE, and Product Management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic software defects with support from your team.

 

What You Will Bring

  • You are in your final year or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with at least 3 years of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledge of programming concepts and experience with at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Go, or JavaScript).
  • Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow as a software professional.


Perks You’ll Enjoy

  • Specialized onboarding and continuous learning opportunities.
  • Competitive pay and the chance to develop skill sets aligned with industry certifications.
  • A multicultural company with strong community support through employee-led groups and local teams.

 

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

 

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between CAD $ 103,000 and CAD $ 155,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.
